metadata.title: Classification of Isometric Immersions of Spherical and HCMU Footballs into $\E^{3}$
metadata.abstract: We study global isometric immersions of rotational metrics with two conical ends into Euclidean three-space. For a metric $g=\mathrm{d}u^2+f(u)^2\mathrm{d}\theta^2$ of positive Gauss curvature, we prove that vanishing endpoint traces of the weighted mixed shape coefficient $f^2b$ force every smooth isometric immersion to be rotational. The resulting congruence classes are parametrized by an integer angular covering degree bounded below by the two cone-angle parameters. The proof combines a scalar elliptic equation derived from the Gauss--Codazzi system, the maximum principle, and a global angular closing condition. For spherical footballs, isolated-singularity theory and a direct estimate in coordinates conformal for the second fundamental form establish the trace condition for every smooth immersion of the regular part. We also classify all rotational isometric immersions of HCMU footballs, including those whose curvature changes sign. When the minimum curvature is nonnegative, this classification exhausts the immersions satisfying the trace condition, and hence all immersions admitting a $C^2$ polar extension at both tips.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 研究带两个锥端的旋转度量在 E³ 中的整体等距浸入，证明正 Gauss 曲率下加权混合形算子系数端点迹消失迫使浸入旋转，并按整数角覆盖度分类。
analysis.breakthrough: 对球面 football 验证端点条件，并得到 HCMU football 的旋转浸入分类。
analysis.limitations: HCMU 一般变号曲率时只分类旋转浸入；非负最小曲率下的穷尽性仍需迹条件或两端 C² 极坐标延拓。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 辅助发展论文，具体参与内容未细分；据此确认披露而不推断模型承担证明。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25232v1 · 第15页 Generative AI disclosure

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 辅助发展论文，具体参与内容未细分；据此确认披露而不推断模型承担证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 锥奇性曲面的整体刚性与浸入问题较具体且可计算。
